args.evidence: stg_customers view (1500 rows) has 288 null market_segment values, while raw.customer has 0 null c_mktsegment. Model SQL uses nullif(trim(c_mktsegment), 'MACHINERY') which turns 'MACHINERY' values into NULL. Query shows exactly 288 rows where c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY', matching the null count. Therefore the nulls are introduced by the model logic, not upstream data. Fix by removing or correcting the nullif expression.
